command: python -B scripts/benchmark_smart_search.py --output RESULT; repeat with --variants baseline --cases whole-five-clue whole-five-clue whole-five-clue; python -B scripts/benchmark_repair_modes.py --output RESULT; repeat with --modes core-repair --wall-seconds 32 --output RESULT. Each RESULT is a fresh path; exact per-case limits and seeds are stored in the corresponding report.

environment.hardware: Intel Core i7-4790 @ 3.60GHz; 4 physical cores / 8 logical processors; one CPU worker per benchmark; no GPU benchmarks in this comparison

mathematics.assertion_tested: Soundness in finite tiny cases and bounded runtime behavior of optional pruning, complete-board repair, and incremental assumption reuse; not solution of Eternity II.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integers, Boolean SAT, finite-domain tables and integer edge-match costs; native CP objective values are checked against integer board scores.
mathematics.conventions: State=4*(piece ID-1)+clockwise rotation; faces NESW; row-major cells; original16x16 with five fixed oriented clues and480 internal edges; regional tasks explicitly limit their constraint edges.
inputs: Bounded selection from previously imported local board archive; hashes of parent arrangements recorded in repair report
Exact measured source SHA256 maps are embedded in each report; pre-update source snapshot retained locally under research/smarter-search-20261013/repair-modes-source

bounds.soft_memory_mib: 1536 for repair;2048 for pruning; cooperative Windows monitoring
bounds.runtime_state: isolated test paths; canonical best andSTOP hashes unchanged

non_claims: No proof that the puzzle is impossible
No statistically reliable fastest algorithm ranking
Completed repair neighborhoods do not establish global optimum
Scores and native decisions are not BOINC work counts

randomness.generator: Python random.Random / solver seed; seeds in reports and finite tests

checks: All report source hashes unchanged during their measurements
Independent validator checked every returned actual board
Tiny exhaustive placement and matching oracles
312-test full regression suite passed after final SAT lifecycle hardening; all eight source exact/smart diagnostics passed; frozen build diagnostics are recorded separately
result: Finite tested assertions passed; every bounded whole-puzzle search was inconclusive. Best466 retained. Incremental SAT reduced repeated build time17.140s to2.094s and handled208 assumption sets instead of8 within the same18s budget.
residual_risks: One desktop CPU, uncontrolled background load, short seeded trials
Legacy manifest schema: exact source hashes and limits reside in reports; no OS-enforced aggregate memory cap
Baseline optimizer report predates small-domain mismatch-bound integration; incremental report predates final API callback-close hardening
Cross-platform native behavior requires the existing CI build matrix; this local run is Windows only
